claims.proposition: In Indonesia, beasiswa denotes financial support for students or other learners to pursue or complete education, including tuition and related costs.
Beasiswa is used in contemporary Indonesian government and scholarship-agency materials for educational funding programs.

Beasiswa is the normal neutral Indonesian term corresponding to English scholarship for financial support awarded to help a student pay for education, although the supplied sources do not prove exclusivity or population frequency.
